scope: CPU-only native38 ownership/error paths; not box evidence

leaves.name: cpu-native38-storage-and-transport
leaves.replaces: GPU model, graph resources and process transport below real driver/worker bridge/router
leaves.equivalence: Real binding types, route state machine and empty barrier; controlled CPU graph/event/network resources preserve ack ordering.
leaves.cannot_prove: Does not prove CUDA graph numerical exactness, real NCCL termination or device performance.

leaves.name: cpu-native38-namespace-wire-adapter
leaves.replaces: CPU transport serialization between generated-package and hub-fixture wire namespaces
leaves.equivalence: Copies dataclass fields/enums into exact destination wire classes; real packaged install_engine, driver, bootstrap and bridge transitions run without replacing their methods.
leaves.cannot_prove: Does not prove pickle/native MQ ABI; preserves types/values, not actual interprocess serialization.

leaves.name: cpu-native38-non-output-peer
leaves.replaces: PP1 blocked in irecv_tensor_dict and GPU rank0 failure
leaves.equivalence: Real generated RPC exception body runs in spawned CPU process; output-rank receiver stays blocked while a real fatal pipe and ReplyTransport fail the pending call.
leaves.cannot_prove: Cannot interrupt actual NCCL or validate CUDA completion; peer termination is a CPU process fixture.

leaves.name: cpu-native38-http-response
leaves.replaces: FastAPI response and middleware decorator on host without FastAPI
leaves.equivalence: Only HTTP response shape is substituted; real health middleware reads the real driver status/proof and never binds. Exact ASGI mapping is additionally required in pinned-image self-run.
leaves.cannot_prove: Host check cannot prove actual FastAPI registration/HTTP ABI.

leaves.name: cpu-native38-constructor-order-only
leaves.equivalence: This older isolated unit test already substitutes NativeSegmentDriver; it checks only provider installation before driver construction. Full real bootstrap is tested in test_native38_plain_bind and test_e3_native_startup_binding.
leaves.cannot_prove: Startup binding, FULL fence or readiness; no claim from this isolated test.

leaves.name: cpu-native38-asgi-client
leaves.replaces: AsyncLLM health client plus device/transport leaves of OwnerStartup.stack
leaves.equivalence: Actual pinned stock health router and real FastAPI/Starlette ASGI execute. The client implements errored/check_health and returns the real driver status through call_utility_async; no owner binding or readiness is faked.
leaves.cannot_prove: Live Core socket readiness, model accuracy or actual CUDA/NCCL teardown.
